facts.fact: Zaiq's status table lists POPIA as in force on 28 September 2026.
facts.system: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013

facts.fact: Zaiq says the Information Regulator enforces POPIA.

Zaiq says the Information Regulator's published guidance notes cover direct marketing, children's information, special personal information and elections, with no AI-specific enforcement action found.
